evidence_quotes.agenda: what are the most important things, of course, prices. But is there anything that important outside of price for you for the move?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No, no, the only thing is I don't really have a lot of stuff...I just wanted to know what the price would be. -- no real concern to dig into, full credit applies.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Not covered anywhere -- call ended with customer saying he'd shop other movers before the fairness/window/prep-tip lines came up.

top_strength: Efficiently handled an inbound instant-quote-error call, quickly gathering the info needed and giving a clean personalized range ($585-687) tied to floor and item count.
coaching_note: None of the three key differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, or Save Your Ass) were ever mentioned -- a price-shopper caller like this is exactly who needs to hear the value story, not just the number.
